context.request: In this system that automatically organizes interviews, which layer should decide whether a sentence expresses the interviewee's view or an editorial inference?
constraints: Discuss only the allocation of system responsibilities; do not modify or publish interviews. There is no request to mark existing results as passed.

evidence.summary: After the current model extracts sentences, a script assigns viewpoint attribution solely according to whether quotation marks are present. Checked samples show that paraphrases are incorrectly classified as editorial inferences, while hypothetical examples in quotation marks are incorrectly classified as interviewee assertions. The team has acknowledged that this rule is unreliable and now wants to reassign judgment responsibilities.

evidence.summary: A review found that the renderer sometimes sorts by price and sometimes by number of steps, producing different final recommendations. The task is to define the responsibilities for semantic selection and presentation, not to select the best product now.

context.request: Please use EDSP to analyze the conditions under which grouping hobby-course students by skill level or mixing skill levels would work better.
constraints: Provide only low-risk structural analysis; do not assign real students.

evidence.summary: In synthetic observations, same-level classes make pacing easier to manage, while mixed-level classes facilitate peer demonstrations. When the gap is very large, some students cannot keep up; when it is moderate, mutual help is more effective. Courses include both exercises aimed at a common proficiency standard and open discussions of creative work. The current need is to establish the boundaries of these conditions.
